fato_historico: 1883: An F5 tornado strikes Rochester, Minnesota, leading to the creation of the Mayo Clinic.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a powerful surge of resilience within. Just as a sudden storm once sparked the foundation for profound healing and medical innovation, you are encouraged to transform your intense emotional experiences into acts of deep compassion. It is a good time to channel your inner depth toward creating something beautiful and restorative for yourself and those around you.
frase_do_dia: From the eye of the storm, you shall build your greatest legacy.
significado_numero: The number of transformation and the culmination of inner wisdom.
conselho: Consider how your past challenges can become the foundation for a brighter future today.
